info.title: MyBuddy API
info.description: REST API for the MyBuddy iOS app. Authenticate with a Firebase ID token: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Real-time events use Socket.IO at `/realtime` (see docs/backend/REALTIME.md).

avatarMediaId.description: READY media id (purpose AVATAR) or null to remove

coverMediaId.description: READY media id (purpose COVER) or null to remove

phoneNumbers.description: Phone numbers from the device address book (any format). Max 5000.

mode.description: replace = this is the whole address book; merge = only add matches (lookups)

clientId.description: Client-generated id; retrying with the same id returns the same post.

mediaIds.description: Media ids from POST /media/upload-url (purpose POST), in display order

draft.description: Save as a draft instead of publishing

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte length of the file that will be uploaded

participantIds.description: One id for a direct conversation, more for a group

clientId.description: Client-generated id; resending with the same id never duplicates

entityId.description: Post/user/media id the event is about

targetId.description: Id of the user, post, comment or message
